scope: RunPod encoding-throughput pilot for the Paper 2 open-population corpus: rent RTX 4090 and A100 (Community Cloud) for under 1 h each, encode about 10k public-domain USPTO documents with PatEmbed-large in fp16, measure passages/s, and check vector parity against the V100 on a 1k subset.
separate_from: the OpenRouter USD 100 sub-ledger (not approved yet); the Paper 1 study ledger
owner_actions: top up the prepaid balance (10 USD)
choose: RunPod MCP via OAuth with per-action approval, or the owner creates pods manually from prepared commands
not_granted: storing an API key in the repo or in logs
sending DAPFAM (CC BY-NC-SA) or Paper 1 test data to RunPod
